cards.back:
Moving in the opposite direction to the hands of a clock. The prefix anti means against.
Bahasa Indonesia: berlawanan arah jarum jam
Example: Turn the key anticlockwise to open the lock.
cards.say: anticlockwise. Moving in the opposite direction to the hands of a clock. The prefix anti means against. Turn the key anticlockwise to open the lock.

cards.back:
The story of a person's life written by that person. The prefix auto means self.
Bahasa Indonesia: otobiografi
Example: Her autobiography tells how she became a famous swimmer.
cards.say: autobiography. The story of a person's life written by that person. The prefix auto means self. Her autobiography tells how she became a famous swimmer.

cards.back:
Able to speak two languages. The prefix bi means two.
Bahasa Indonesia: dwibahasa
Example: My bilingual cousin speaks both Indonesian and English.
cards.say: bilingual. Able to speak two languages. The prefix B I means two. My bilingual cousin speaks both Indonesian and English.

cards.back:
To sail all the way around something. The prefix circum means around.
Bahasa Indonesia: berlayar mengelilingi
Example: Magellan's expedition was the first to circumnavigate the world.
cards.say: circumnavigate. To sail all the way around something. The prefix circum means around. Magellan's expedition was the first to circumnavigate the world.

cards.back:
To work together. The prefix co means together.
Bahasa Indonesia: bekerja sama
Example: If we cooperate, we can finish the model in an hour.
cards.say: cooperate. To work together. The prefix C O means together. If we cooperate, we can finish the model in an hour.

cards.back:
To rot or break down into simpler parts. The prefix de means away or undo.
Bahasa Indonesia: membusuk
Example: Leaves decompose and turn into rich soil in the forest.
cards.say: decompose. To rot or break down into simpler parts. The prefix D E means away or undo. Leaves decompose and turn into rich soil in the forest.

cards.back:
Very unusual and special. The prefix extra means beyond.
Bahasa Indonesia: luar biasa
Example: She showed extraordinary courage when she saved her friend.
cards.say: extraordinary. Very unusual and special. The prefix extra means beyond. She showed extraordinary courage when she saved her friend.

cards.back:
To communicate or act with other people. The prefix inter means between.
Bahasa Indonesia: berinteraksi
Example: Pupils interact in the playground at lunch break.
cards.say: interact. To communicate or act with other people. The prefix inter means between. Pupils interact in the playground at lunch break.

cards.back:
Having many colours. The prefix multi means many.
Bahasa Indonesia: berwarna-warni
Example: A multicoloured kite flew high above the beach on Sunday.
cards.say: multicoloured. Having many colours. The prefix multi means many. A multicoloured kite flew high above the beach on Sunday.

cards.back:
Writing about real facts and events. The prefix non means not.
Bahasa Indonesia: nonfiksi
Example: I borrowed a non-fiction book about volcanoes from the library.
cards.say: non-fiction. Writing about real facts and events. The prefix non means not. I borrowed a non-fiction book about volcanoes from the library.

cards.back:
To move an event to a later time. The prefix post means after.
Bahasa Indonesia: menunda
Example: The match was postponed because of the heavy rain.
cards.say: postpone. To move an event to a later time. The prefix post means after. The match was postponed because of the heavy rain.

cards.back:
A bike with three wheels. The prefix tri means three.
Bahasa Indonesia: sepeda roda tiga
Example: The toddler pedalled a red tricycle around the garden.
cards.say: tricycle. A bike with three wheels. The prefix T R I means three. The toddler pedalled a red tricycle around the garden.

cards.back:
Not at ease. The prefix un means not.
Bahasa Indonesia: tidak nyaman
Example: The hard chair was uncomfortable after an hour of sitting.
cards.say: uncomfortable. Not at ease. The prefix un means not. The hard chair was uncomfortable after an hour of sitting.

cards.back:
Against the law. The prefix il means not, and is used before the letter l.
Bahasa Indonesia: ilegal
Example: It is illegal to drive without a licence.
cards.say: illegal. Against the law. The prefix I L means not, and is used before the letter l. It is illegal to drive without a licence.

cards.back:
Not following a normal pattern. The prefix ir means not, and is used before the letter r.
Bahasa Indonesia: tidak teratur
Example: The word mice is an irregular plural of mouse.
cards.say: irregular. Not following a normal pattern. The prefix I R means not, and is used before the letter r. The word mice is an irregular plural of mouse.

cards.back:
A feeling of pleasure. The suffix ment makes a noun.
Bahasa Indonesia: kesenangan
Example: The children showed great enjoyment while they played in the sand.
cards.say: enjoyment. A feeling of pleasure. The suffix ment makes a noun. The children showed great enjoyment while they played in the sand.

cards.back:
Willing to try new and exciting things. The suffix ous means full of.
Bahasa Indonesia: suka petualangan
Example: The adventurous girl tried a food she had never eaten.
cards.say: adventurous. Willing to try new and exciting things. The suffix O U S means full of. The adventurous girl tried a food she had never eaten.

cards.back:
Able to be turned around or undone. The suffix ible means able to be.
Bahasa Indonesia: dapat dibalik
Example: The reversible jacket can be worn on either side.
cards.say: reversible. Able to be turned around or undone. The suffix I B L E means able to be. The reversible jacket can be worn on either side.

cards.back:
A person who studies science. The suffix ist means a person who does.
Bahasa Indonesia: ilmuwan
Example: The scientist tested the water from the pond.
cards.say: scientist. A person who studies science. The suffix I S T means a person who does. The scientist tested the water from the pond.

cards.back:
A hopeful way of thinking. The suffix ism makes a noun.
Bahasa Indonesia: optimisme
Example: His optimism helped the team keep trying after the loss.
cards.say: optimism. A hopeful way of thinking. The suffix I S M makes a noun. His optimism helped the team keep trying after the loss.

cards.back:
Without any hope. The suffix less means without.
Bahasa Indonesia: tanpa harapan
Example: The lost tourist felt hopeless until he saw a signpost.
cards.say: hopeless. Without any hope. The suffix less means without. The lost tourist felt hopeless until he saw a signpost.

cards.back:
The bond between friends. The suffix ship makes a noun.
Bahasa Indonesia: persahabatan
Example: Their friendship grew stronger with every shared adventure.
cards.say: friendship. The bond between friends. The suffix ship makes a noun. Their friendship grew stronger with every shared adventure.
